name: @dsh-external/dsh-webshell-mgr
description: DSH webshell manager host plugin: session tab beside hunter with connection registry and protocol auto-detect (self-developed AES opcode channel, one-liner cmd/eval, modified-manager variants, stock manager compat), command exec / virtual terminal, file manager (binary-safe transfer, chmod, timestamp forge, remote fetch), database console (PDO native over eval-capable shells, CLI fallback), shell generator, declarative payload-plugin system discoverable by sessions, model tools for the five security presets, and a stdio MCP server sharing the same core.
author: SeaOf0
